description: A listen host stages an asymmetric original Grid room extension during private Combat. A rejected extension preserves the candidate and resident world. The host verifies its native dependency packages. The creator lacks the exact arena and acknowledges the review. After Continue, the host saves an ordinary variant and plays the staged archive in a fresh round. Both remote peers remain in the Room throughout.
